digest.component_or_area: completion verifier, plan-review acceptance criteria tagging
propositions: Rename the canonical acceptance-criteria qualifier from [operator-attested] to [non-codebase] to clarify that the tag indicates WHERE evidence lives (outside codebase) rather than WHO attests it
[operator-attested] must be retained as an undocumented but recognized compatibility alias because 827 of 4,285 existing tickets (19%) carry the tag in immutable event-sourced records

The regex pattern must accept both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] case-insensitively using a non-capturing alternation to preserve findall() arity and prevent tuple breakage in findall() calls

All five deterministic consumers of the compiled regex (decide_ops, workflow_ops, det_attestation_launder, det_measurement_provenance, txn.py ensure_ac_boxes_checked) must behave identically when given either tag spelling
The completion-verdict kind wire value must transition from operator-attested to non-codebase with reader-widening sequenced before emitter-change to keep 827 legacy verdicts rendering

Both tag spellings must be recognized in the .rebar/criteria_routing.json activation trigger and all recognition-side prompts so plan-time lint, laundering guard, provenance guard, and close path behave identically
